findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze, brand_match, bulk_available, sale_chance · Private data: active, analyze, brand_match, dns, domain_changes, expired, expired_analysis, keywords_trends, monitor, name_advisor, sale_chance, strategy, tld_check · Public sink: analyze, brand_match, dns, keywords_trends, market_price, nrds, ns_reverse, sale_chance · Destructive: brand_match, bulk_available, expired, expired_analysis, get_strategies, keyword_intel, monitor, name_advisor, plan_b, preferences, sale_chance, strategy, trend_hunter, valuation_cma.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze, brand_match, bulk_available, sale_chance · Private data: active, analyze, brand_match, dns, domain_changes, expired, expired_analysis, keywords_trends, monitor, name_advisor, sale_chance, strategy, tld_check · Public sink: analyze, brand_match, dns, keywords_trends, market_price, nrds, ns_reverse, sale_chance · Destructive: brand_match, bulk_available, expired, expired_analysis, get_strategies, keyword_intel, monitor, name_advisor, plan_b, preferences, sale_chance, strategy, trend_hunter, valuation_cma

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
